userStories.title: Substantive-session definition + weekday streak
acceptanceCriteria: cadence.py defines is_substantive_session(row) as session_score row exists AND user_turns >= 2 AND elapsed_seconds >= 60, with the threshold constants exposed as module-level constants.
compute_weekday_streak(profile_store, ending_on_date) returns the count of distinct weekdays in the last N=21 days (configurable) that contain at least one substantive session.
A user with no substantive sessions in the window returns streak=0 (not None) and the function never raises on an empty profile_store.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis

userStories.title: High-adopter spectrum positioning
acceptanceCriteria: cadence.py exposes high_adopter_position(streak, window_days) returning an enum-like literal in {'low','moderate','high'} with thresholds documented and cited to arXiv 2509.19708.
A window_days value <= 0 raises ValueError before any DB read; a streak greater than window_days raises ValueError (invariant check).
The function output is deterministic for fixed inputs and covered by parameterised tests at every threshold boundary.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
